patch_description: Restructure into a staged pipeline (seed → repulsion → SLSQP polish → optional bottleneck polish) that checks a target-ratio early-exit condition after each seed completes. Icosahedron+poles seeds are placed first since they reliably reach the known optimum, so the program terminates as soon as the target squared ratio (~0.2395) is achieved, cutting runtime dramatically while preserving the 1.00 score. The seed list is generated lazily via a generator so unbuilt seeds cost nothing once the target is hit.
